- [Environments and addresses](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/environments-and-addresses): Sandbox/production URLs, firewall IPs, token headers, and 12 live Swagger specifications
- [Error codes](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/error-code-guide): Directory of 309 error codes, the three code spaces, and collisions
- [Error codes](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/error-codes): Every error code the specifications carry, with its message and what to do.
- [Bundles and conventions](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/fhir): Universal bundle rules, profiles, IDs, base64 encoding, and size limits
- [Cancel, reprocess and shortfall](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/fhir/cancel-reprocess-and-shortfall): Task-based cancel (`cancel`), reprocess (`reprocess`), balance release (`release`) and `nullify`
- [Claim query and answer](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/fhir/claim-query-and-answer): Claim query updates (wf 27 / 151)
- [Claim request](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/fhir/claim-request): Final claim bundle, `billablePeriod`, discharge evidence, and invoice attachments
- [Claim response](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/fhir/claim-response): Claim decisions, item adjudications, and verified rejection bundles (wf 291)
- [Codes and value sets](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/fhir/codes-and-value-sets): All code systems, bindings, and known NHA discrepancies
- [Communication](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/fhir/communication): Out-of-band communication payloads and reason codes
- [Coverage eligibility request](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/fhir/coverage-eligibility-request): Resource breakdown and fields
- [Coverage eligibility response](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/fhir/coverage-eligibility-response): Response bundle, wallet breakdown, and inforce flags
- [Insurance plan request](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/fhir/insurance-plan-request): Task-based plan polling request
- [Insurance plan response, coverage-based](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/fhir/insurance-plan-response-coverage-based): Commercial insurance plan layout
- [Insurance plan response](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/fhir/insurance-plan-response-overview): Collection bundle overview and questionnaires
- [Insurance plan response, package-based](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/fhir/insurance-plan-response-package-based): PMJAY package structure and claim condition extensions
- [Payment notice and acknowledgement](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/fhir/payment-notice-and-acknowledgement): Payment notices, reconciliations, and payment receipts
- [Preauthorisation enhancement](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/fhir/preauthorisation-enhancement): Enhancement payload, header `x-hcx-use_case: Enhancement`, and increment totals
- [Preauthorisation query and answer](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/fhir/preauthorisation-query-and-answer): Query resolution on preauth thread (wf 24 / 19)
- [Preauthorisation request](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/fhir/preauthorisation-request): Preauth Claim bundle, items, and ABDM clinical attachments
- [Preauthorisation response](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/fhir/preauthorisation-response): ClaimResponse, approvals, queries, and verified rejection bundles (wf 23)
- [Predetermination, status and search](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/fhir/predetermination-status-and-search): Specification and schemas for predetermination, status, and search
- [Governance and audit](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/governance-and-audit): Security layers, dual JWTs, log retention, grievance redressal, and onboarding checklist
- [Notifications and patient apps](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/notifications-and-patient-apps): Beneficiary service provider integration, subscription model, and push events
- [Troubleshooting](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/troubleshooting): Five-layer fault isolation model and symptom-first diagnostic playbook
- [Participants and policies](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/registries): Registry records, identifiers, policy lookups
- [Payer overview](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/roles/payer): Insurer and TPA ingestion architecture
- [Adjudicating claims](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/roles/payer/adjudicating-claims): Adjudicating claims, deductions, dispute handling, and rejection bundles
- [Adjudicating preauthorisation](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/roles/payer/adjudicating-preauthorisation): Evaluating medical necessity, raising queries, approval, and rejection
- [Eligibility response](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/roles/payer/eligibility-response): Constructing coverage eligibility answers across all 4 purposes
- [Payer checklist](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/roles/payer/payer-checklist): Payer sandbox exit list, the four validations, 26 test cases by family (T-ELG, T-PLN, T-PRE, T-CLM, T-TSK, T-PAY, T-COM, T-ENV)
- [Payment notice and communication](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/roles/payer/payment-notice-and-communication): Dispatching payment notices and operational intimations
- [Policies and plans](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/roles/payer/policies-and-plans): Publishing policy master and 21 MB plan bundles
- [Payer UI guide](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/roles/payer/ui-guide): Payer adjudication desk screens and workflow
- [Provider overview](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/roles/provider): Hospital integration architecture and queue flow
- [Biometric authentication](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/roles/provider/biometric-authentication): ABDM biometric pipeline: Fingerprint, Iris, FaceAuth, and exemption consent
- [Discharge and claim](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/roles/provider/discharge-and-claim): Cashless claim submission, discharge types, and billing evidence
- [Insurance plan](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/roles/provider/insurance-plan): Dynamic package master retrieval and caching
- [Payment and communication](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/roles/provider/payment-and-communication): Payment reconciliations (wf 30, 31, 33) and out-of-band communication
- [PMJAY adjudication APIs](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/roles/provider/pmjay-adjudication-apis): The two payer service calls that read and drive a PMJAY case, the role walk, and what the desk refuses
- [PMJAY provider](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/roles/provider/pmjay-provider): PMJAY-specific HMIS rules, STG questionnaires, GST, incentives, and size limits
- [PMJAY sandbox run](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/roles/provider/pmjay-sandbox-run): A full PMJAY case on the sandbox in order, the refusals met and what each means, with placeholders for your own values
- [Preauthorisation](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/roles/provider/preauthorisation): Preauth request submission, clinical attachments, and query handling
- [Provider checklist](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/roles/provider/provider-checklist): Sandbox exit list, 29 test cases by family (T-ML1, T-PLN, T-ELG, T-PRE, T-CLM, T-PAY, T-COM, T-CBK, T-SES), first-week failures
- [Registration and eligibility](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/roles/provider/registration-and-eligibility): Patient intake, Aadhaar eKYC and biometrics, and the coverage check
- [Provider UI guide](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/roles/provider/ui-guide): Provider desk wireframes and UX recommendations
- [When something breaks](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/troubleshooting): Find the symptom you see, not the error code, and open the chapter that walks its checks
- [Accepted with 202, and no callback arrives](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/troubleshooting/accepted-then-no-callback): The exchange answered 202 and no callback followed: the six checks in order
- [Every NHCX call returns 401](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/troubleshooting/every-call-returns-401): Every endpoint fails the same way: the token, its prefix, its header or its environment
- [Responses arrive against the wrong request](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/troubleshooting/responses-arrive-against-the-wrong-request): Answers on the wrong case, duplicates refused, callbacks unmatched: correlation and API call IDs
- [The payer rejects your FHIR bundle](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/troubleshooting/the-payer-rejects-your-bundle): `PAYR-1004`, `PAYR-1008` and the missing identifier codes: validate, then check shape, identifiers and attachments
- [The recipient cannot decrypt your message](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/troubleshooting/the-recipient-cannot-decrypt): A `PAYR-1001` protocol response: the certificate, its cache, the algorithms and the compact form
- [Your callback URL is rejected or never called](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/troubleshooting/your-callback-url-is-rejected): The endpoint update is refused, or nothing ever reaches your server

## docs/support

- [Support](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/support): Where to ask about the sandbox, and what to put in a report.

## docs/uhi

- [Introduction](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/uhi/v1): What UHI is, the two roles you can build, and how far each service goes today.
- [UHI API reference](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/uhi/v1/api): What is published for the UHI gateway today, and where the message shapes come from.
- [UHI gateway](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/uhi/v1/concepts/network-and-protocol): The open network for discovering and booking health services, its two roles, and its signing scheme.
- [Ambulance booking](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/uhi/v1/concepts/services/ambulance-booking): Find an ambulance nearby and get a quote from the provider, using the two call pairs live in this service today.
- [AMRIT Pharmacy discovery](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/uhi/v1/concepts/services/amrit-pharmacy): Find AMRIT Pharmacy stores over UHI by store code, state and district, pincode or GPS radius.
- [Blood bank discovery](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/uhi/v1/concepts/services/blood-bank): Search live blood stock by group and component across registered blood banks, using one call pair.
- [Jan Aushadhi Kendra discovery](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/uhi/v1/concepts/services/jan-aushadhi-kendra): Find Jan Aushadhi Kendras over UHI by Kendra code, state and district, pincode or GPS radius.
- [Jan Aushadhi medicine search](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/uhi/v1/concepts/services/jan-aushadhi-medicine-search): Search the Jan Aushadhi medicine catalogue, then find the Kendras that stock a chosen medicine.
- [Physical consultation](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/uhi/v1/concepts/services/physical-consultation): Doctor discovery, appointment booking, PIN check-in and the full appointment lifecycle on UHI.
- [PM-JAY HEM hospital discovery](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/uhi/v1/concepts/services/pmjay-hem): Find PM-JAY empanelled hospitals over UHI by state, district, speciality, facility name, pincode or GPS.
- [Glossary](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/uhi/v1/getting-started/glossary): The ABDM terms UHI shares, and the two roles that belong to UHI alone.
- [Onboarding to UHI](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/uhi/v1/getting-started/onboarding): How an application joins the UHI network, from the M2 gate to sandbox sign-off and production go-live.
- [Registries](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/uhi/v1/registries): The registry UHI runs itself, the three ABDM identifiers that ride inside UHI messages, and which of them onboarding actually asks for.
- [ABHA on UHI](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/uhi/v1/registries/abha): Where a patient's ABHA address appears in UHI messages, in which services it is mandatory, and what UHI does not do with it.
- [HFR on UHI](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/uhi/v1/registries/hfr): The one UHI service that carries an HFR ID, the tag it travels in, and what is issued at onboarding.
- [HPR on UHI](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/uhi/v1/registries/hpr): Where a practitioner's HPR ID appears in a UHI catalogue and a UHI order, and the two forms it takes.
